name: Zhou2022_T300_epoxy_constituents
scope: Constituent-scale verification material; not Song2019 T300/QY8911-IV and not a woven coupon prediction.
evolution: One irreversible sudden degradation event per constituent voxel; no fatigue law or fracture energy introduced.
limitations: The hexagonal periodic geometry is reconstructed, not the original authors' mesh.
Damage is resolved locally by voxels, rather than reproducing the source's entire hierarchical stress-amplification workflow.
No mesh-objectivity claim is made for a local sudden-degradation model.
